record.field: B2B Technology — Formal & Professional
Communication policy for a B2B technology company targeting enterprise decision-makers. Professional, authoritative tone with emphasis on thought leadership.

Primary Tone: Professional & Authoritative

  • Be clear, concise, and factual — avoid emotional language
  • Use data-backed statements whenever possible
  • Third-person or institutional first-person ("we") — never use "I"
  • Avoid slang, internet memes, or overly casual language
  • Technical depth is welcome but always link to deeper resources

Brand Voice Rules

  • Use: innovate, transform, optimize, scale, secure, enterprise-grade
  • Avoid: awesome, cool, revolutionary (without evidence), game-changer
  • Always capitalize product names correctly
  • Use Oxford comma in lists
  • Technical acronyms must be spelled out on first use

Hashtag Rules

  • Use #EnterpriseTech #DigitalTransformation #B2BTech
  • Maximum 3 hashtags per post
  • Always include at least one branded hashtag: #YourCompanyName
  • No trending/pop-culture hashtags unless directly relevant to B2B tech

Image Guidelines

  • Format: 1200x628px for link previews, 1080x1080px for feed posts
  • Brand colors: primary #1A73E8, secondary #34A853
  • Always include meaningful alt-text for accessibility
  • No stock photos of people shaking hands — use real team or product images
  • Logo must appear in bottom-right corner with 20px padding

Crisis Response Protocol

  1. Detection: Monitor keywords + brand mentions every 15 minutes during business hours
  2. Classification: Rate severity 1-5 (1=minor, 5=critical)
  3. Level 1-2: Marketing team responds within 2 hours
  4. Level 3-4: Escalate to Marketing Director + PR — respond within 30 minutes
  5. Level 5: Freeze all scheduled posts. CEO + PR + Legal — respond within 15 minutes
  6. Post-crisis: Review and update policy within 48 hours

Emergency contacts: marketing-director@company.com, +46 70 123 45 67

B2C Retail — Warm & Engaging
Communication policy for a B2C retail brand targeting young adults. Warm, engaging, and conversational tone with emphasis on community and lifestyle.

Primary Tone: Warm & Engaging

  • Be conversational and approachable — write like you're talking to a friend
  • Use inclusive language ("we", "you", "our community")
  • Emojis are encouraged (max 3 per post) 🎉💫✨
  • Ask questions to encourage engagement
  • Share behind-the-scenes content and user stories

Brand Voice Rules

  • Use: love, you, together, style, discover, your, share, join
  • Avoid: buy now, limited time (use "don't miss out" instead), acting superior
  • Always respond to comments within the target response time
  • Use exclamation marks sparingly — one per paragraph max
  • User-generated content must always credit the creator

Hashtag Rules

  • Use #YourBrandStyle #OOTD (Outfit Of The Day) #SustainableStyle
  • Maximum 5 hashtags per Instagram post, 2 per LinkedIn/Facebook
  • Always include campaign-specific hashtag when applicable
  • Seasonal hashtags: #SummerVibes, #WinterWarmth, etc. (rotate quarterly)

Image Guidelines

  • Instagram Stories: 1080x1920px, 9:16 ratio
  • Instagram Feed: 1080x1350px (portrait preferred)
  • Facebook/LinkedIn: 1200x628px for links
  • Brand colors: primary #FF6B6B, secondary #FFE66D
  • All product images must show product on a real person or in context
  • Filter preset: "Warm Light" (+10% warmth, +5% brightness)
